name: Observe.AI
tagline: Observe.AI uses AI to analyse 100% of contact centre interactions — calls, chats, and emails — for quality assurance, compliance, and coaching. Its real-time agent assistance feature provides live guidance during calls. Contact centres use it to improve CSAT scores, ensure compliance, and reduce agent onboarding time.
